prompt: One uninterrupted cinematic photoreal shot. Beautiful authentic rain-after-sunlight atmosphere, soft daylight, natural colors, pale luminous air, premium documentary cinematography, smooth physically plausible camera movement, no cuts, no on-screen text, no logo, no diagrams. Low drone camera glides forward at walking speed above a quiet wet tree-lined residential street after a brief shower. Soft sun emerges behind the camera, puddles shimmer, and one faint but distinct natural rainbow arch appears in the distant sky above the street. The rainbow has continuous smooth color order, red outside violet inside. Keep the arch near the central upper part of the screen. Subtle foreground parallax, realistic scale, no people close to the camera.
negative_prompt: text, subtitles, watermark, logo, diagrams, drawn rays, laser beams, arrows, blue wedge, optical wedges, neon colors, fantasy rainbow, abrupt cuts, glitch, flicker, distorted architecture, pointed teardrop, cartoon, plastic CGI
purpose: Generated realistic atmosphere/transition only. Geometrical rainbow angles and ray tracing are computed separately.
recommended_insert: Opening, first 5 seconds; follow into local rainy street world
decode_strategy: Real video decoded to every actual CFR frame; random-seek-safe all-intra backup. No still-image pan.
quality_review: Actual decoded-frame contact sheet reviewed; pixel-motion screening complete. Full subjective playback not claimed.
usage_decision: Use a right-biased crop that excludes source x<560, or a subtle upper-left foreground branch mask. Opening atmosphere only, not evidence of sun geometry.
